blocking_finding: socks_negative accepts any nonzero SOCKS REP after reading as little as two bytes, then reports a TEST-NET-3 rejection. The same function accepted a local credential-free fake server returning truncated b\x05\x01 (2 bytes) and a full b\x05\x05 generic failure. Neither proves MATCH,REJECT was selected; a malformed reply or unrelated proxy failure can be counted as the intended negative. Existing fixtures test REP=2 and REP=0 only, so they miss this false-success class. This is material to the v2b stated negative oracle and cannot justify root release.
